items.html: We shall explain the order of these nine Sefirot that divide within Arich Anpin. Now, Arich Anpin differs from all the rest, for in all the other Partzufim — whether of Atik, of Aba ve Ima, or of Zeir Anpin and Nukva — their Rosh is a single skull (Galgalta), which is the aspect of the crown (Keter) of the Partzuf, for ‘Keter’ has the meaning of a crown, as in ‘the wicked encircles the righteous,’ meaning surrounds him; and the skull is like a single crown that surrounds the whole aspect of the head. Within this skull there are two Mochin, called the Hochma-Bina (HB) of that Partzuf: Hochma on the right, and Bina on the left. These two are the essential Mochin. However, from the combination of both of them a third brain is formed below them, deciding between them in their midst, and this is called the Daat of the Partzuf. And what does not enter into the count of the ten Sefirot of the Partzuf, we shall explain, please God. And all these three Mochin are, and they are set within this skull called Keter; and after this, seven lower Sefirot expand: HGT, Netzach, Hod, Yesod, Malchut, in the body, one atop the other, in the manner of lines, as is known.
